_comment: Everything the three targets agree on. scripts/build.mjs merges this with
the per-target overlay in manifest.<target>.json and writes the result to
dist/<target>/manifest.json. Edit this file, not the generated ones.
manifest.json at the repo root is the Chrome build, kept in place so the
repo still loads unpacked with no build step — see the README.
name: butter_jira
description: Gantt, Backlog, and Kanban views across your Jira boards. Because the other one sucks.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com
